items.raw_excerpt: "The incident was caused by a human error in developing the email distribution code with an AI tool," said the Personal Data Protection Commission.

Singapore's Personal Data Protection Commission said the error happened while developing the email distribution code. It is the first AI-linked data breach reported in the country.

items.raw_excerpt: Karnataka Prantha Raitha Sangha (KPRS) has urged the Central government to impose an appropriate tariff on red gram imported from other countries and guarantee the Minimum Support Price (MSP) for domestic red gram growers.
